messages:
Sam (AE): Quick sync 1 Marina's POC wants two Order Forms (Entity A billed, Entity B pays) + a 5% holdback for 90 days. They also want parallel signing. Can legal/finance confirm we can accept and how to route?

Priya (Sales Ops): We can do parallel lanes in DocuSign. Sam, please confirm signer emails and whether they want simultaneous completion or sequential. Also need tax docs.

Sam (AE): Emails: legal@entitya.com, finance@entityb.com. They asked for simultaneous signing. I'll ask Marina for W-9/W-8 now.

Marina (Customer): Confirmed. We'll attach W-9 for Entity A and W-8BEN-E for Entity B. Simultaneous signing is preferred to avoid delays.

Jordan (Legal): We can accept multi-entity flows but prefer a single MSA with multiple OFs attached. Redline suggestions: (1) clause that Billing Entity = invoiced party; Payor Entity = allowed payer with wiring instructions, subject to intercompany agreement evidence; (2) holdback release tied to written acceptance or milestone completion; (3) cap on total holdback exposure. I'll draft a 1-paragraph redline.

Kenji (Finance): Finance tentatively ok. Requirements: W-9/W-8 for tax, bank beneficiary form with routing/payee details, PO if needed. Note: 5% holdback impacts revenue recognition and may delay invoice clearance. We need to record as "holdback liability" until release.

Sam (AE): Jordan 1 can you paste the redline text we should include in the OF so I can push to the customer? They're asking for signatures today.

Jordan (Legal): Proposed redline paragraph: `If Customer consists of multiple legal entities, the Order Form shall identify the Billing Entity (the entity that shall be invoiced) and may reference a separate Payor Entity for payment purposes. Redwood shall accept wiring instructions for a Payor Entity provided Customer delivers (a) an executed intercompany agreement evidencing the Payor/Billing relationship, and (b) tax and bank documentation for each entity. Any contractual holdback shall be limited to 5% of the Order Form value, released upon (i) Redwood's written acceptance of the applicable POC deliverables or (ii) mutual written agreement. Redwood reserves the right to limit aggregate holdback exposure to the total value of services provided under the POC.`

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope with parallel lanes and an internal checkbox "holdback applies" to route the OF to Finance for approval before completion. Sam, please upload the docs to the envelope.

Marina (Customer): Uploading W-9 + W-8 now. Also attaching a short intercompany memo that shows Entity B pays Entity A invoices.

LegalBot: Template ref: https://internal.redwood/legal/templates/OF-multi-payor-guidance.pdf. Jordan, upload when ready.

Jordan (Legal): Uploaded redline v1 to Legal drive and inline change to OF. Quick note: ask customer to accept the exact acceptance criteria in the SOW so we can tie holdback release to objective milestones.

Kenji (Finance): Finance will mark the order as "Pending docs" in the billing system until we receive bank beneficiary and tax forms. If simultaneous DocuSign completes but docs are missing, Ops will block activation.

Sam (AE): Understood. I'll hold the envelope completion until docs attached. Marina 1 if you can add bank form to the envelope that would be ideal.

Marina (Customer): Done. Bank form attached. Also can we add a clause allowing Redwood to invoice Entity A and accept bank transfer from Entity B? That's what our treasury needs.

Jordan (Legal): That's covered by the redline: Billing Entity invoiced, Payor Entity permitted to pay with intercompany evidence. I'll add a line requiring authorized signer representation for each entity.

Priya (Sales Ops): SFDC: tagging thread with `needs-legal` and `needs-finance`. Creating internal ticket to track DocuSign flow and activation hold.

Kenji (Finance): After docs verified we'll clear for activation. ETA for review: 1 business day. If revenue recognition issues arise we'll flag accounting.

Sam (AE): Thanks all. Plan: finalize redline (Jordan), collect docs (Marina), load parallel DocuSign lanes (Priya) and hold until Finance confirms. Aiming to complete EOD but likely tomorrow after finance review. :thumbsup:
